title: Normalized phase range by scorer
description: Median six-phase score range divided by the score IQR for two FNS scorers and three token scorers on the 500-variant BRCA2 MAVE-derived MVE subset.
source_note: Values are the 500-variant rows from the experiment's scorer-instability summary. A dashed horizontal reference marks the predeclared 0.10 auxiliary threshold.
qa_note: Value labels are raised from the renderer's 17px default to 20px after rendering so they remain legible in the 600px stress preview.
